panels.title: Accounts
panels.description: sub2api accounts with a supported quota or balance.

targets.expr: count(llm_quota_account_info{job="llm_usage"})

panels.title: ≥ 90% used
panels.description: Accounts with at least one window at 90% or more (red bars); at 100% they are throttled until it resets.

targets.expr: count(max by (provider, account_id, account_name) (llm_quota_used_ratio{job="llm_usage"}) >= 0.9) or (0 * count(llm_quota_account_info{job="llm_usage"}))

panels.title: 70–90% used
panels.description: Accounts whose most-used window is between 70% and 90% (yellow bars).

targets.expr: count(max by (provider, account_id, account_name) (llm_quota_used_ratio{job="llm_usage"}) >= 0.7 < 0.9) or (0 * count(llm_quota_account_info{job="llm_usage"}))

panels.title: Fetch failing
panels.description: Accounts whose last quota fetch failed, excluding rejected keys and hosts without a balance API.

targets.expr: sum((llm_quota_up{job="llm_usage"} == bool 0) * (1 - llm_quota_key_blacklisted{job="llm_usage"}) * llm_quota_endpoint_supported{job="llm_usage"})

panels.title: Keys rejected
panels.description: Keys rejected with 401; skipped for 6h or until the key changes in sub2api.

targets.expr: sum(llm_quota_key_blacklisted{job="llm_usage"})

panels.title: sub2api DB
panels.description: Whether the exporter could read accounts from the sub2api database on its last reload.

targets.expr: max(llm_exporter_db_up{job="llm_usage"})

panels.title: GLM · 3 accounts
panels.description: GLM accounts (5h, Weekly). Bars show the share of each window used: green below 70%, yellow below 90%, red above. Reset is the time until that window resets.

targets.expr: max by (provider, account_id, account_name) (llm_quota_account_info{provider="zhipu", job="llm_usage"})
max by (provider, account_id, account_name, plan) (llm_quota_plan_info{provider="zhipu", job="llm_usage"})
max by (provider, account_id, account_name) (llm_quota_used_ratio{window="5h", provider="zhipu", job="llm_usage"})
max by (provider, account_id, account_name) (llm_quota_reset_timestamp_seconds{window="5h", provider="zhipu", job="llm_usage"}) - time()
max by (provider, account_id, account_name) (llm_quota_used_ratio{window="weekly", provider="zhipu", job="llm_usage"})
max by (provider, account_id, account_name) (llm_quota_reset_timestamp_seconds{window="weekly", provider="zhipu", job="llm_usage"}) - time()

(max by (provider, account_id, account_name) (llm_quota_key_blacklisted{provider="zhipu", job="llm_usage"}) == 1) * 2 or (max by (provider, account_id, account_name) (llm_quota_endpoint_supported{provider="zhipu", job="llm_usage"}) == 0) + 3 or max by (provider, account_id, account_name) (llm_quota_up{provider="zhipu", job="llm_usage"})

panels.title: Accounts
panels.description: Fetch details per account. Data age is how old the numbers are; HTTP is the last upstream status (0 = no response).

targets.expr: max by (provider, account_id, account_name, platform, status, schedulable) (llm_quota_account_info{job="llm_usage"})
max by (provider, account_id, account_name, plan) (llm_quota_plan_info{job="llm_usage"})

(max by (provider, account_id, account_name) (llm_quota_key_blacklisted{job="llm_usage"}) == 1) * 2 or (max by (provider, account_id, account_name) (llm_quota_endpoint_supported{job="llm_usage"}) == 0) + 3 or max by (provider, account_id, account_name) (llm_quota_up{job="llm_usage"})
time() - max by (provider, account_id, account_name) (llm_quota_last_success_timestamp_seconds{job="llm_usage"})
max by (provider, account_id, account_name) (llm_quota_last_http_status{job="llm_usage"})

panels.title: Fetch status
panels.description: Per-account fetch result over time. No API: the account's host (a relay) has no balance endpoint.

targets.expr: (max by (provider, account_id, account_name) (llm_quota_key_blacklisted{job="llm_usage"}) == 1) * 2 or (max by (provider, account_id, account_name) (llm_quota_endpoint_supported{job="llm_usage"}) == 0) + 3 or max by (provider, account_id, account_name) (llm_quota_up{job="llm_usage"})
